mapper.sql: s.story_id, s.author_id, s.title, s.intro, s.category, s.cover_url, s.status, s.reject_reason, s.play_count, s.like_count, s.favorite_count, s.comment_count, s.create_time, s.update_time, u.nickname AS author_name
mapper.select: SELECT , (s.play_count + 2*s.like_count + 3*s.favorite_count + 4*s.comment_count) AS heat FROM story s LEFT JOIN `user` u ON s.author_id=u.user_id WHERE s.status=2 ORDER BY (s.play_count + 2*s.like_count + 3*s.favorite_count + 4*s.comment_count) DESC, s.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM story s LEFT JOIN `user` u ON s.author_id=u.user_id WHERE s.status=2 ORDER BY s.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story) AS totalStories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story WHERE status=2) AS publishedStories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story WHERE status=1) AS pendingStories, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(play_count),0) FROM story) AS totalPlays, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE status=0) AS pendingReports
